title: Marianna NDE 20456
content:
I was having an ectopic pregnancy and had to undergo major surgery, I was told that I had two minutes to half an hour to survive. As two doctors met me in the surgery, I remember at the time thinking this is it. I am not going to recover from this, as the pain was unbearable. I remember floating towards a bright light, I was calm and I wanted to go towards it, I was aware that I had my grandparents waiting for me on the other side, and I was very, very calm. I heard a female voice. She told me that it wasn't my time and that I had to go back. I was disappointed. The next thing I remember was another female voice, that of the nurse, telling me it was time to wake up. There was also another nurse that came up to her and asked if I was all right, the nurse informed her colleague that I was. I found out later that it was more serious than they had thought at the time and that I had to have one tube removed and that I had to be revived as my blood pressure was very low.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death See account.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I was journeying in my body I wasn't out of it, well that how it felt.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I didn't see anyone, but I heard a voice and was aware of people being there.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a bright light the sort of light that you experience when you are in a tunnel and coming out the other side.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm There was no difference.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe It felt spiritual, I believed in Heaven and God at the time, but was not as certain as I am now.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes It changed my outlook on life. Life is precious; you only get one chance at it. I also go to church more so than before.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The shock of having that experience, coming out of it and learning from it.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told my mom, it was very emotional because of the fact that this was life threatening anyway.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: A couple of the questions seem to duplicate themselves, but other than that they are very good questions because they make you explain them better, as you have to recall the emotion you felt at the time.
